business_model.claim: The company sells expedition cruises and land-based adventure travel, and has done so since 1979.
quotes: Lindblad has been providing marine expedition adventures and active travel experiences globally to its guests since 1979.

business_model.claim: Its largest customer group is affluent U.S. individuals aged 50 or older. The company says it keeps premium pricing rather than discounting for the broader market.
quotes: affluent individuals in the U.S. aged 50 years or older representing our largest demographic category

business_model.basis: Stated in the 10-K segment table and Item 1.
business_model.claim: The company reports two segments: Lindblad (ship-based expeditions) and Land Experiences. In the latest 10-K year, tour revenues were $495,642 (table in thousands) for Lindblad and $275,377 (table in thousands) for Land Experiences, a total of $771,019 (table in thousands).
quotes: The Lindblad segment consists primarily of ship-based expeditions aboard customized, nimble and intimately-scaled vessels that are designed for discovery

business_model.claim: Land Experiences groups the land-based brands. The latest 10-Q adds the White Desert and Echo Charlie businesses to this segment.
quotes: (ii) the Land Experiences segment, consisting of our Natural Habitat, Off the Beaten Path, DuVine, Classic Journeys brands, the Thomson Group, White Desert and Echo Charlie.

business_model.basis: Stated in the 10-K line-item description and yield table.
business_model.claim: Revenue comes from guest tickets plus other tour revenue such as excursions, hotels, air, onboard sales and trip insurance. In the Lindblad segment, guest ticket revenues were $428,349 (table in thousands) and other tour revenue was $67,293 (table in thousands).
quotes: guest ticket revenues recognized from the sale of guest tickets

business_model.claim: Revenue growth in the latest 10-K year came from both volume and price. Of a $126.3 million increase, $96.8 million came from 13% more guest nights sold and 16% more guests, and $29.5 million came from pricing and itinerary mix.
quotes: Of the $126.3 million increase, $96.8 million was due to a 13% increase in guest nights sold and a 16% increase in guests traveled, and $29.5 million was due to increased pricing and changes in the mix of itineraries and trips.

business_model.claim: In the latest quarter, Lindblad segment revenue rose $15.8 million to $153.4 million (11%), on occupancy of 91%, a 4% rise in available guest nights and a 6% rise in net yield to $1,398.
quotes: Lindblad segment tour revenues of $153.4 million increased $15.8 million, or 11%, compared to the third quarter a year ago primarily due to an increase in occupancy to 91% on a 4% increase in available guest nights, driving a 6% increase in net yield to $1,398.

business_model.claim: In the latest quarter, Land Experiences revenue rose $13.2 million to $115.8 million (13%), driven by more guests and more trips.
quotes: Land Experiences tour revenues of $115.8 million increased $13.2 million, or 13%, compared to the third quarter a year ago primarily due to an increase in guests and operating additional trips.
